old_findings.remaining_scope: F01 separately covers the newly introduced raw-path fallback under already-enabled but no-running-host conditions.
Nonblocking observation N01 covers live standard history work outliving the host lease; it does not claim stale marker recovery still fails.
Strict GetAddonDetails/GetAddons fallback preserves unknown rather than treating failures as a disabled snapshot.

findings.title: 已 enabled 但宿主未运行时，按文件路径 RunScript 启动绕过 addon 身份和 service 生命周期
findings.precondition: Kodi still reports plugin.video.bobbi enabled, its prior service interpreter has ended, and no live Runtime owns the stable lease; ensure_running therefore executes its raw-path recovery fallback.
demonstrated_impacts: Native: real background_service import chain reaches a bare xbmcaddon.Addon(), fails with missing interpreter addon identity, and recovery ends CINEMA_SERVICE_NOT_READY.

Standard: actual Host/Runtime can answer ready from the untracked invocation, but a later real KodiHost.quiesce disables only the managed service handle; the recovered manual host keeps its OS lease and returns CINEMA_SERVICE_NOT_STOPPED.
positive_controls: The same real native imports succeed with normal provider addon context.
An actual standard Host started through the managed-service IO path becomes ready and subsequently quiesces normally.
findings.oracle: Enabled-but-not-running recovery must start the actual service with valid Kodi identity and ownership so the same installer can later stop it.
scope_limits: No real Kodi or CE device was executed; exact upstream Kodi 21.3-Omega C++ invocation behavior is represented at the IO boundary.
The demonstrated failure is the fallback branch. Normal managed enable is a passing control; the finding does not assert that every installation fails.
Setting an explicit default xbmcaddon ID alone would not register the manual script with ServiceAddonManager; simply using RunScript(addon_id) does not promise the service extension.
fix_requirements: Use Kodi's managed service lifecycle for restarting an already enabled but dead provider, or implement an equally explicit supported ownership mechanism that establishes service extension identity and stop/exit acknowledgement.
Retain actual owner readiness, boot gate, stable runtime inode, enable-vector readback and replay high-watermark rules.

Add an execution test for actual native imports with the fallback invocation identity and a standard fallback start -> second installer quiesce cycle; fake enabled/ready replies alone cannot validate either contract.

observations.title: 标准播放历史 writer 仍在执行时，安装器已获得替换代次的 OS lease
observations.precondition: Standard HistoryWriter has an admitted write still in disk IO for longer than its 0.3-second close join, or a remaining queue that has not drained.
demonstrated_impacts: With real StandardPlayback, HistoryWriter, set_watched_file, Host, Runtime and KodiHost, quiesce succeeded in approximately 0.4 seconds while the old writer was alive.
With the installer's actual runtime lease still held, releasing the controlled final database IO allowed two old writes to occur after quiesce returned.
positive_controls: With the same two real history requests fully drained first, shutdown and quiesce succeed, no history worker remains alive, and no old write occurs after replacement permission.
observations.oracle: The runtime lease authorizing source generation replacement must remain owned while admitted old-generation work can still execute imports or persistent writes.
scope_limits: The final database persistence boundary is a controlled IO double writing only temporary review data. User data corruption has not been demonstrated or claimed.
The script calls actual product close methods in portable_runtime.main's exact finally order, rather than executing an entire real Kodi interpreter.
Kodi waits for interpreter threads, but its asynchronous Disabled acknowledgement/readback does not provide an independent barrier to the installer's runtime-lease admission.
This is distinct from the now-passing R02 process-loss/stale-marker case.

Independent peer challenge: real PickleDatabase has its own cross-process flock and atomic operation-merged writes; the two observed writes remain in valid order, and the history implementation did not change in this PR. These facts limit inference from late writes to a concrete current-upgrade failure.
Retain as a nonblocking hardening observation; do not count its diagnostic exit code as a release gate until a user-visible effect or explicit stronger shutdown requirement is established.
fix_requirements: Account for the standard history, next-candidate and subtitle workers in the host shutdown ownership protocol; stop admission and cancel where safe before draining or waiting.
Retain the runtime lease until workers have ended or have been made incapable of further old-generation effects. A join timeout alone is not evidence of quiescence.

Add real StandardPlayback/HistoryWriter shutdown coverage alongside existing HTTP/engine/catalog lease checks; ensure normal shutdown remains available and blocked work fails recoverably without granting replacement permission.
